statement: Let x be a singular closed point of a normal complex algebraic fourfold X. Suppose that KX is Q-Cartier and X is klt near x, with zero boundary. Then ˆ vol(x, X) ≤ 162. Equality holds if and only if the complex analytic germ is ( {z2 0 + z2 1 + z2 2 + z2 3 + z2 4 = 0}, 0 ) . No isolatedness, complete-intersection, quotient, or smoothability assumption is made. For k ≥ 2 set pk = 2 ( k − 1 k )k . (2.3)
